question: Should Crabline preserve the existing stable recorderPath and safely tolerate or migrate pre-existing artifact directories, or intentionally ship generation-scoped recorder paths and fail-closed ownership as a breaking contract?
rationale: Automated tests can verify either implementation, but they cannot decide the public artifact and upgrade contracts existing operators should receive.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility
options.body: Keep the stable recorderPath and add safe handling for existing uid mismatches while retaining the new durability mechanisms.

options.title: Version The Contract
options.body: Introduce an explicit artifact schema version and documented migration before changing recorderPath and directory ownership behavior.

options.title: Accept The Break
options.body: Ship the new fail-closed and generation-scoped behavior only with explicit maintainer ownership and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve Compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the stable recorderPath and add safe handling for existing uid mismatches while retaining the new durability mechanisms.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current persistence implementation and responded to the first review cycle.
